title: cadintent findings and check runs
description: The typed finding shape shared by pack checks and render reports. Findings concern design content that did land — distinct from refusals. Every finding names what it was judged against (a rule citation with its verification status, a pack vocabulary, or a pack schema expectation) and carries the values it judged. A check that could not run reports not_run visibly — never a pass; a vacuous pass (nothing to judge) is distinguishable from a real one; consistency with an unverified rule entry is a distinct status that never reads as compliance. Spec version 0.1.0.

CheckStatus.description: The closed per-check outcome set: 'pass' (judged, no findings, every judgement backed by verified rules or spec-level comparisons), 'findings' (one or more findings), 'unverified_consistent' (no findings, but at least one judgement rested on an unverified placeholder — visible, never compliance), 'not_run' (a required value was missing; never a silently invented default).

RuleJudgement.description: Judged against a rule-registry entry: the citation pins {registry, version, name}, and 'verification' carries the entry's status at judgement time.

params.description: The parameter values the judgement matched against, when applicable.

VocabularyJudgement.description: Judged against a versioned pack vocabulary (e.g. recommended materials). Off-list values are findings, never refusals.

SchemaJudgement.description: Judged against a pack schema expectation or spec-level structural comparison, named in 'rule' with the tolerance applied (checks own tolerances; the kernel has none).

Judgement.description: What a finding or check was judged against — never implicit.

Finding.description: One finding: which check raised it, the subject objects, the values carried (both sides of any disagreement — e.g. declared and derived flow), and the rule/tolerance judged against.

subjects.description: The design objects the finding concerns, by ULID.

values.description: The values the finding carries — check-specific keys, always including both sides of any comparison.

message.description: Human prose; outside any conformance contract.

CheckResult.description: One check's outcome. 'evaluated' counts the subjects actually judged; 'vacuous' is true when that count is zero, so an empty pass is visibly distinguishable from a real one. A not_run result names why in 'reason'. 'consulted' lists every judgement source the check resolved (visible even when nothing fired).

consulted.description: Every judgement source the check resolved and consulted.

reason.description: For not_run: exactly what required value was missing and where to supply it.

CheckRun.description: One check-runner invocation over a folded model: which spec and pack judged, at which log head, with every check's result — including visible not_run and vacuity.

project.description: The project ULID, or null when the model is empty.
